title: Targa expedition (1490)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Targa expedition (1490)", at revision 1370749696, opens: "The Portuguese Targa expedition took place in 1490 when a Portuguese fleet commanded by Dom Fernando de Meneses plundered the town of Targa, a known pirate haven in Morocco. On the same occasion, Dom Fernando sacked the Moroccan mountain town of Comice." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q116763820, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1490 expedition during the Moroccan-Portuguese conflicts". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
